svg.title: A rule becomes a check
svg.desc: A refund rule starts as advice in docs/refunds.md. The agent writes it as an invariant in refund.spec. specforge check --strict fails with W003: invariant 'refund_within_capture' is not enforced by any behavior. specforge explain W003 says to reference it from the behaviors that must preserve it. The agent adds invariants [refund_within_capture] to issue_refund, the check passes with 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 infos, and the agent goes from unsure to certain.

g.text: docs/refunds.md: the agent may read it, or not.
The agent drafts refund.spec. A program reads it.
W003: the rule is enforced by nothing.
specforge explain tells the agent what to link.
Same files, same verdict, every run.
- Refunds never exceed the captured amount.
advice: nothing checks that any code follows it
a sentence: true until someone forgets
a node in a graph, with an id
the exact line the hint asks for
